guide_body:
• Dots / bars: nafa min bɛ san kelen-kelen bɛɛ la.
  • Bold colored curve: a LOESS smoother: the local trend, free to bend, o la aw bɛ se ka a ye ko hakɛ bɛ Changé waati kɔnɔ (misali la, funteni bɛ teliya o kɔfɛ ~1985).
  • Layini tigɛlen: tilennen barikama (Theil-Sen) taabolo; a jiginni ye “san tan kɔnɔ” jate ye nsiirin kɔnɔ.
  • p<0.05 / n.s.: Mann-Kendall nafa: ni ŋaniya in ye jatebɔ ye tiɲɛ ye walima ni a bɛ se ka kɛ mankan dɔrɔn ye (n.s. = a tɛ nafa sɔrɔ). A ka c’a la, funteni nafa ka bon kosɛbɛ; sanji ka teli ka kɛ o tɛ.
  • Bandi sumayalen: tariku hakɛ dafalen san bɛɛ kɔnɔ o kalo in na.
  • Fuma kariti kulɛriw: funteni (nɛnɛ bulu → sumaya bilenman) kalansen dɔ kalan ka bɔ duguma ka taa sanfɛ walasa k’o kalo yeli lajɛ sanw kɔnɔ.

cap_yearly: San o san hakɛ ni LOESS smoother (a bɛ teliya jira) ani Theil-Sen trend +significance barikama
cap_anomalies: San o san ni i y’a suma ni san 1961-1990 hakɛ cayalenba ye: bara bilenmanw ka suma, buluw ka nɛnɛ. Yɛlɛma min bɛ Bɔ a fanba la bulu la ka Taa a fanba la bilen na, o ye sumaya ye.
cap_heatmap: Kalo o kalo cɛmancɛ la san o san i n’a fɔ kulɛri jatebɔ (2 °C bands). Aw ye sɛbɛnfura dɔ kalan san fɛ walasa k’o kalo lajɛ a sumayalen don san tan caman kɔnɔ.
cap_anom_heatmap: Grid kelen, nka kalo o kalo bɛ suman n’a yɛrɛ ka 1961-1990 normal ye, o la, fɛn caman b’a jira ko fɛn caman b’a jira ko (bilen ka suma ka tɛmɛ a cogo kɔrɔ kan, bulu ka nɛnɛ), waatibolodacogo bɔra.
cap_threshold: Tile minnu bɛ kɛ san o san ka tɛmɛ 18 °C kan (funteni) ani 0 °C duguma (nɛnɛ). O ŋaniya barikama fila minnu bɛ tɛmɛn, o kɔrɔ ye ko tile funtenimanw ka ca ni nɛnɛ donw ye sisan.
hint: Yɔrɔ o yɔrɔ digi walima ka Esc digi walasa ka da tugu
intro: Diɲɛ dugubaw sumana cogo min na kabini san 1940: don o don funteni hakɛ sɛbɛnw ka bɔ ERA5 ka waati sɛgɛsɛgɛli seginni na.

cap_volatility: Don o don funteni jiginniba bɛ kɛ siɲɛ joli san o san (≥6 °C), funteni caman ɲɔgɔnna
precip_title: Sanji hakɛ min bɛ na san o san, {name}.
cap_precip: Sanjiko bɛɛ lajɛlen san o san (sanji ni nɛnɛ ji) ni ŋaniya ye
cap_stripes: Sɛrɛ kelen-kelen bɛɛ ye san kelen funteni ye: bulu ka nɛnɛ, bilen ka suma ka tɛmɛ san 1961-1990 hakɛ kan. Kɔrɔbɔli ka Bɔ bulu la ka Taa bilen na, o ye sumaya ye, foyi tɛ kàlan ni kulɛri tɛ.
cap_season: Sumaya falen waati janya san o san (tile boli ni don o don cɛmancɛ ye ≥ 5 °C): finɛtiri sɛnɛ min tɛ nɛnɛ ye, o bɛ bɔ o la, a bɛ janya ni waati bɛ sumaya.
dtr_ylabel: Don o don hakɛ cayalenba − min (°C).
cap_dtr: Don kelen-kelen bɛɛ ka sanfɛla ni a dɔgɔyalen cɛ danfara min bɛ yen. A yɔrɔ min bɛ dɔgɔya, o ye serifiyɛri ye: suw bɛ sumaya joona ka tɛmɛ tile kan; min bɛ bonya, o bɛ se ka jalen taamasiɲɛ jira.
seasonshift_ylabel: Kalo o kalo funteni hakɛ dantɛmɛnen (°C).
cap_seasonshift: San hakɛ danmadɔ min bɛ kɛ san fɔlɔ ni san tan labanw na minnu ye jatebɔ kɛ. Kurukuruw ni ɲɔgɔn cɛ danfara min bɛ kalo o kalo, o b’a jira san yɔrɔ minnu ka suma kosɛbɛ (a ka c’a la, nɛnɛ bɛ kɛ ka tɛmɛ samiyɛ kan).
health_sub: Sumaya taabolo minnu bɛ sanfɛ, olu bɛ baara kɛ cogo min na ka kɛ funteni, nɛnɛ ani ko juguw jirali jateminɛw ye minnu dɔnna. Tablo kelen-kelen bɛɛ bɛ bɔ yɔrɔ min na a mago bɛ kunnafoniw bɛ sɔrɔ yɔrɔ min na.
cap_degreedays: San o san funteni-dusu doni: funteni mago (18 °C duguma) bɛ bin ka sɔrɔ nɛnɛ mago (22 °C sanfɛ) bɛ wuli, o ye nɛnɛ sɔrɔli ni fiɲɛdilan ɲinini proxy ye.
cap_heatwave: Tile minnu bɛ funteni na: boli min bɛ kɛ tile ≥3 kɔnɔ ni don o don hakɛ bɛ tɛmɛ sigida 1961-1990 kɛmɛsarada la 90nan kan. Tile funteni min bɛ to senna, o de ye funteni-taama tɛmɛnen sababuba ye.
tropic_title: Su minnu bɛ kɛ yɔrɔw la minnu ka timi san kɔnɔ, {name}.
cap_tropic: Su minnu na ni duguma bɛ to 20 °C la walima ka tɛmɛ o kan, o la farikolo tɛ lafiya sɔrɔ su kelen kɔnɔ, o ye saya sababuba ye min bɛ sɔrɔ funteni fɛ, min bɛ to ka ɲinɛ a kɔ.
cap_coldspell: Tile minnu bɛ kɛ nɛnɛ waati la: boli min bɛ kɛ tile ≥3 kɔnɔ ni don o don dɔgɔya bɛ sigida 1961-1990 kɛmɛsarada la 10nan duguma. Nɛnɛ min bɛ mɛn sen na, o bɛ dusukun ni ninakili tɛmɛnenw bila mɔgɔ la nɛnɛ waati.
cap_heavyrain: Tile minnu na sanji bɛ na milimɛtɛrɛ 20 ni kɔ (ETCCDI R20mm), sanjiba minnu bɛ na ni joginw ye, ka mɔgɔw bila yɔrɔ wɛrɛw la ani ka bana minnu bɛ sɔrɔ ji fɛ.
heatindex_title: Farati bɛ funteni-index tile la san kɔnɔ, {name}.
cap_heatindex: Tile minnu na funteni jiralen (funteni hakɛ, min bɛ foli nɛnɛ na) bɛ se funteni-degun hakɛ ma, foroba funteni ladilikanw bɛ baara kɛ ni o ye. Mako bɛ kunnafoni-falen-falen-yɔrɔ la min bɛ ye.
